title: Add payroll snapshot database service
description: Create an app-owned SQLite payroll snapshot service with schema initialization, snapshot CRUD, active snapshot selection, capture from current payroll result, and reconstruction back to the existing payroll response shape.
convergence: Schema creates payroll_snapshots, payroll_snapshot_employees, payroll_snapshot_components, payroll_snapshot_raw_sources, and payroll_snapshot_events.
Service exposes init, create, list, get, activate, soft delete, and buildPayrollResultFromSnapshot functions.
Snapshot create uses a transaction and rolls back on partial insert failure.
Only one active snapshot per period is allowed.
